HexKagune 1.0.12 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**War's mask, fixed**
- **The mask keeps its shape wherever your kakugan is.** In 1.0.11 a high-placed kakugan dragged the mask with it: a bare patch of face opened up under the eye, a plate hung over the bare skin, and the forehead ring was pushed onto the eye. Now only the eye moves. The mouth opening never gets bigger, only the plates and cracks the eye would land on make way, and the ring moves across the brow only when the eye sits right under it.

Checked in renders made with the game's own model code, for the usual eyes, high, low and wide eyes, and a one-eyed right kakugan (mirrored mask). The build passes the full verifier and the dedicated-server check.
